# Buffed round — SRD 5.1

The same template, params and dice as `../buffed-round-srd-5.2.1/`. Both editions describe
*bless* identically, which is the point: the arithmetic below is the same, and the only
difference in the outcome is the ogre.

SRD 5.1 prints the ogre with **59** hit points (7d10 + 21); SRD 5.2.1 prints **68**
(8d10 + 24). Three hits of 7 leave it on 59 − 21 = **38** here, against 47 there. Nothing
marks the ogre `sapped`, because SRD 5.1 has no weapon mastery.

The derivation is in the 5.2.1 case's README; the citation for this edition is
*Spell Descriptions > Bless*.
